Almost half of California’s adults with disabilities get the treatment they need to thrive through Medicaid. Donald Trump and House Republicans want to take that away. 

Today, Shane, a constituent of mine from Irvine joined me to share how access to Medicaid allows him to thrive in our community.

Access to reproductive care IS healthcare. 

This week, I toured a Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) facility to hear directly from providers about the risks women and infants will face if Republicans can enact their draconian cuts to Medicaid.

Cutting Medicaid is bad for patients. Without it, they will not receive any support, all while forcing hospitals to increase costs.

Without Medicaid, they will not be able to receive the care that they need to remain healthy and productive members of society. 4/4 https://t.co/myQcYbSPq2
I’m deeply saddened to hear of President Biden’s cancer diagnosis. My thoughts are with him and his family and I’ll be praying for his recovery.

House Republicans are cutting $1 trillion from Medicaid in order to give tax breaks to billionaires. These cuts will devastate our healthcare system. Without funding from Medicaid, hospitals will close, preventing people from receiving life saving care when they need it most. We must protect Medicaid.

Three years ago, SCOTUS eliminated the Constitution’s core protections for privacy and access to reproductive healthcare. 

Since then, Republicans have launched an all out assault on reproductive freedoms.

I’ll keep fighting to protect the personal liberties of every American.

Through cancer screenings, prenatal care, and maternity care, Planned Parenthood saves lives. 
 
This is a terrible decision that will make it harder for those in need to seek the care they require.
https://t.co/O2v8ThkoL9

Senate Republicans are voting to cut Medicaid, food stamps, and other life saving services just to give a $3.8 BILLION tax cut to the richest people in the world.

Families will go hungry, hospitals will close, and people will die all so that billionaires don’t have to pay their fair share.

Senate Republicans just chose billionaires over working families.

17 million Americans will lose their healthcare — the largest Medicaid cut ever. Kids, seniors, and veterans will go hungry.

All to give tax breaks to the top 1%.

House Republicans need to grow a spine and reject this abomination.

A few months ago, I met with Mercedes and her 5-year-old son Dino. Dino is battling brain cancer. If Republicans' Big Ugly Bill passes, Mercedes will be unable to pay for Dino’s cancer treatment.

With this bill, Congressional Republicans will take healthcare away from millions of families in need.

Republicans just passed the biggest Medicaid cut in history in order to give tax breaks to to billionaires.

This big abomination of a bill is a disaster for Californians and will kill the American Dream for hardworking people. https://t.co/OfWHKWtG1y

From the biggest Medicaid cut in history to trillions in tax breaks for billionaires, you’ve all heard me talk about the awful pieces of the Big Ugly Bill.

But here’s one you might’ve missed: it also immediately guts funding for Planned Parenthood. Watch me explain what this means for OC families👇

Medicaid saves lives. 

On the 60th anniversary of Medicaid, I wanted to highlight some of the people who’ve shared their stories of how Medi-Cal changed their lives. 

I’ll keep fighting to defend Medi-Cal and ensure every American has access to high quality, affordable health care.

I’ll be doing a press conference with @PPFA in an hour on the devastating impacts that the Republican Big Ugly Bill will have on reproductive healthcare, including access to abortion, contraceptives, and OB-GYN care.

From HIV/AIDS treatment to housing and food assistance, @radianthealthoc provides essential care to the most vulnerable members of our community. Republican cuts to Medicaid will threaten thousands of patients here and devastate Orange County. I’ll keep fighting to protect these critical services.

A court just upheld Congressional Republicans’ efforts to defund Planned Parenthood.

This will devastate women, preventing them from receiving the lifesaving reproductive care they need. 
 
I’ll keep fighting to restore this vital health care.
https://t.co/5Ny3s5qG0h

Republicans’ Big Ugly Bill delivers the deepest Medicaid cuts in history, forcing hospital closures and putting care out of reach for millions. These disastrous policies will hurt Californians.

That is why I’ll continue to fight to protect Medicaid and lower health care costs for every family.

30,000 families in the OC are about to lose their healthcare and thousands of scientists are set to lose their jobs due to massive cuts to research (including cancer research) at universities like UC Irvine.

I’m in DC ready to work to keep the government open, but House Republicans are on vacation.

Republicans are spreading all sorts of lies about the shutdown. Here's the facts: Families are about to get notices that their health insurance premiums have more than doubled.

15 million Americans are relying on us. We must protect their affordable health care. https://t.co/9U14baHUon

.@speakerjohnson just cancelled votes next week, once again putting politics above the American people. 
 
Instead of lowering health care costs for millions of Americans, Republicans are extending their vacations while premiums are about to soar.

Over the last nine months, we have seen an unprecedented assault on our health care from Republicans and the Trump administration. 

I want to hear how their attempts to rip away health care are affecting you. You can share your story with my team here: https://t.co/JQsppXvIPr https://t.co/YURSfs8wMZ

People are suffering every day with this government shutdown. Yet, the GOP refuses to do anything to help the 15 million Americans, including 30k members of our community, who stand to lose their health care. There are real consequences here. We must protect affordable health care in this country.

Republicans want to steal health care from 15 million Americans and raise costs for millions more. This affects all of us. Whether you rely on Medi-Cal or have private insurance, this will cause your premiums to skyrocket.

I’ll keep fighting to make health care affordable for everyone.

Republicans’ health care scheme won’t just strip health care from 15 million Americans, it will also lower the standard of care for everyone else.  
 
@SpeakerJohnson — you created this crisis. It’s time to bring the House back and work to protect health care. Lives depend on it. https://t.co/63t7sqK2qE

Republican cuts to Medicaid are already hurting families. Covered California notices are going out now with increases of 50-200% due to the cuts to ACA subsidies. We must keep fighting for affordable health care. https://t.co/MeOAeNyIJ6
